proof_idea: Model the endpoint Turan determinant as cur^2 - prev*next.
Assume the adjacent endpoint ratios supplied by the Jacobi binomial recurrence.
Clear nonzero denominators and normalize by ring arithmetic to expose beta-alpha or alpha-beta.
Use denominator positivity and square nonnegativity to derive the cone nonnegative and wrong-cone negative sign theorems.
scope_limits: This proves the algebraic endpoint obstruction skeleton, not Gasper's full Jacobi Turan theorem.
It assumes the adjacent endpoint-ratio recurrence as input.
It does not prove interval positivity inside the valid parameter cone.
